newsitem.title: USA: Sargento recalls cookies over unlabeled milk.
newsitem.headline: Sargento recalls cookies over unlabeled milk.

text.p: Sargento Foods said Thursday it is recalling its MooTown Snacks Graham Cookies & Sprinkled Vanilla Creme because the creme may contain nonfat dry milk that is not listed on the package.
People who have an allergy or severe sensitivity to dairy ingredients should not consume the product, the company said.

The company initiated the recall after one consumer report of a minor allergic reaction. Subsequent investigation revealed that nonfat dry milk was inadvertently omitted from the ingredient list, the company said.

The MooTown Snacks Graham Cookies & Sprinkled Vanilla Creme was distributed nationally through retail supermarkets, mass merchants, discount and drug stores in 1-ounce, 5-ounce, 8-ounce, 10-ounce and 15-ounce packages. No other flavor varieties of MooTown Snacks are affected by the recall.
